title: Dataset and benchmark limitations
outcome: Explain dataset and benchmark limitations using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: A benchmark can miss the intended setting. A plant model is evaluated on clean indoor photos but proposed for shaded outdoor photos.
given: Indoor benchmark: 9/10 correct. No outdoor cases are present. The same model is intended for both.

steps.label: Name measured setting
steps.detail: All ten benchmark images are clean indoor photos.

explanation: A benchmark represents particular tasks and collection conditions. High performance on it cannot automatically establish fitness for a different deployment setting.

counterfactual.change: Add four reserved outdoor cases, of which two are correct.
counterfactual.prediction: Report the outdoor slice as 2/4=50%, separately from indoor results.
counterfactual.reason: The new records finally measure the missing condition, with a small denominator.

student_task: Report the indoor benchmark with its denominator and missing condition. After two correct outdoor cases out of four are added, what slice rate is supported and what remains uncertain?
teacher_answer: All ten benchmark images are clean indoor photos. The observed indoor score is 90%. Outdoor shade performance remains unmeasured. Changed case: Report the outdoor slice as 2/4=50%, separately from indoor results. The new records finally measure the missing condition, with a small denominator.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: Neither slice estimates all future photos; inspect sampling, labels and grouping.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
